title: About Dar Global PLC
text: Dar Global PLC is an international luxury real estate developer listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). Originally founded as the international development arm of Saudi Arabia's Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company (listed on Tadawul), Dar Global was spun off to create world-class second homes, vacation properties, and branded residences for affluent international investors. Led by CEO Ziad El Chaar, Dar Global collaborates with global luxury brands including Automobili Lamborghini, Pagani, Elie Saab, Missoni, Aston Martin, The Trump Organization, Mouawad, and Marriott W Hotels. The company's active portfolio spans prime international markets: Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Wadi Safar), UAE (Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah), Oman (Muscat), Qatar (Doha, Simaisma), Spain (Costa del Sol, Benahavís), and the United Kingdom (London).

title: DarGlobal Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Property Acquisition & Ownership
text:
Frequently Asked Questions regarding purchasing with DarGlobal:
1. Can foreigners buy freehold property in DarGlobal developments?
Yes. DarGlobal developments in Dubai, Oman (AIDA), Spain, Qatar (Qetaifan Island North), and London are situated in designated freehold zones where foreign and international buyers have 100% freehold title ownership.

2. Does buying a DarGlobal property qualify for Golden Visa / Residency?
Yes. In the UAE, property purchases above AED 2,000,000 qualify buyers for the 10-year UAE Golden Visa. In Oman, AIDA purchases qualify for Omani Investor Residency. In Spain, qualifying purchases over EUR 500,000 provide eligibility for the Spanish Golden Visa.

3. What payment plans are offered?
DarGlobal typically offers flexible off-plan payment plans, commonly linked to construction milestones (e.g., 20% down payment, 50% during construction, and 30% upon completion or handover).

4. How does DarGlobal differ from Wasalt?
DarGlobal is a premier international property developer creating bespoke, high-end branded residential communities across multiple countries. In contrast, Wasalt is a comprehensive Saudi real estate brokerage marketplace and portal connecting buyers, tenants, and brokers to thousands of individual residential and commercial listings across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

title: DarGlobal Brand Partnerships & Architectural Design
text:
DarGlobal specializes in co-branding with global luxury automotive, fashion, and hospitality leaders:
- Automobili Lamborghini: Tierra Viva villas in Benahavís, Spain.
- Pagani Automobili: DaVinci Tower overlooking the Dubai Canal.
- The Trump Organization: Trump Mansions at Wadi Safar Riyadh, Trump Plaza Jeddah, Trump International Golf Club & Hotel at AIDA Oman, and Trump Simaisma Qatar.
- Elie Saab: Les Vagues waterfront apartments on Qetaifan Island North, Qatar.
- Missoni: Urban Oasis along Dubai Water Canal and Marea in Finca Cortesin, Spain.
- Aston Martin: The Astera beachfront residences on Al Marjan Island.
- Mouawad: $234.6 Million luxury residential mansion project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
- W Hotels / Marriott: W Residences Dubai Downtown.

title: DarGlobal Investor Relations & Financial Disclosures (LSE: DAR)
text: Dar Global PLC is incorporated in the UK and listed on the London Stock Exchange Main Market under the ticker 'DAR'. The company adheres to the UK Corporate Governance Code and strict IFRS accounting standards. Dar Global maintains a debt-light business model, partnering with local landholders and prestigious international brands to deliver high return-on-equity luxury developments across Europe and the GCC.
